mara.activity: Make coffee and toast, then check the weather and transit alerts at the kitchen island. I keep the blue mug at the island center when I finish.
mara.intention: Start the day quietly while staying aware of transit conditions and how Daniel seems to be doing.

mara.activity: Wash up, get dressed, and gather my work things. I take the work laptop from the padded backpack on the bedroom-two desk, put it back in the backpack, and carry the backpack to the entry.
mara.intention: Get ready efficiently without disturbing Daniel or asking him to help.

mara.activity: Commute to the municipal office with my work backpack and transit badge.
mara.intention: Travel to work and monitor any delays.

mara.activity: Handle messages, meetings, and transportation planning work, including reviewing street-project maps and preparing for the revised traffic-plan deadline.
mara.intention: Keep the workday focused while making a note to check on Daniel promptly afterward.

mara.activity: Finish work and travel to the grocery store and pharmacy.
mara.intention: Pick up the planned groceries and prescription without extending the errand unnecessarily.

mara.activity: Shop for groceries and pick up the prescription, then travel home with the bags.
mara.intention: Bring home what we need so Daniel can rest and neither of us has to make another trip.

mara.activity: Put groceries away, change into comfortable clothes, and check quietly on Daniel. I make ginger tea and carry it to the right side of the living-room coffee table without asking many questions.
mara.intention: Settle the house and support Daniel while watching for signs that he is worsening.

mara.activity: Prepare a simple dinner for myself and bring a plate, fork, and glass to the dining table. I eat quietly and leave space for Daniel to rest rather than expecting conversation.
mara.intention: Have dinner without making Daniel feel responsible for entertaining or cooking.

mara.activity: Clear my dinner things to the kitchen, wash them, and do a small reset of the counters and entry. I put my keys in the maple console's left drawer.
mara.intention: Reduce visual and practical clutter before settling down for the night.

mara.activity: Do gentle stretching on the yoga mat and watch a quiet television episode, keeping the volume low. I check on Daniel without pressing him to talk.
mara.intention: Keep the evening calm and remain available if Daniel needs something.

mara.activity: Put away the tea things, wash up, take my prescription if due, and change into pajamas. I leave my reading glasses on the living-room side table if I used them there and put my phone on its charger.
mara.intention: Prepare for bed while keeping the recovery area orderly enough for tomorrow.

mara.activity: Get into bed and read a few quiet pages before turning out the light.
mara.intention: Rest early so I can be attentive tomorrow if Daniel is still unwell.

daniel.activity: Wake feeling chilled and congested, use the bathroom, wash my hands and face, and drink water slowly.
daniel.intention: Assess how sick I am and manage the first symptoms without trying to push through them.

daniel.activity: Sit on the closed toilet lid and call the service office to report that I cannot work today, then send the necessary cancellation messages from my phone.
daniel.intention: Take responsibility for the repair route before resting.

daniel.activity: Take my allergy tablets and a dose of cold medicine with water, then move slowly to the bedroom and lie down.
daniel.intention: Reduce congestion and avoid making the illness worse by getting dressed or driving.

daniel.activity: Sleep or doze under the quilt while Mara gets ready for her day.
daniel.intention: Let the sudden fatigue pass without trying to keep up with the normal morning routine.

daniel.activity: Wake for water and a little banana, then leave the mug and peel on the bedside surface rather than attempting a proper breakfast.
daniel.intention: Get something gentle down and stay hydrated.

daniel.activity: Rest quietly in bed, answering Mara briefly when she checks on me and keeping tissues nearby.
daniel.intention: Sleep through the worst of the morning and avoid spreading the cold around the house.

daniel.activity: Get up carefully, wash my hands, refill my water bottle, and use the bathroom.
daniel.intention: Take a short, manageable break from bed without overexerting myself.

daniel.activity: Lie on the sofa with the throw blanket, listen to quiet television for a while, and doze when the congestion makes reading impossible.
daniel.intention: Rest somewhere comfortable while keeping the bedroom available for deeper sleep.

daniel.activity: Eat a few spoonfuls of yogurt and drink water, then put the bowl and spoon in the kitchen sink.
daniel.intention: Try a small, easy lunch without asking my stomach or energy for much.

daniel.activity: Return to the sofa and sleep, keeping my phone within reach in case the office needs clarification.
daniel.intention: Stay quiet and available while the illness runs its course.

daniel.activity: Check in with Mara by text, drink more water, and take my temperature.
daniel.intention: Reassure her without interrupting her work and make sure the symptoms are not escalating.

daniel.activity: Rest in bed again, mostly asleep, with tissues and water beside me.
daniel.intention: Conserve what little energy I have instead of attempting chores or paperwork.

daniel.activity: Wake, wash my hands, and sit quietly while Mara brings or sets aside something plain for me; eat only what I can manage.
daniel.intention: Have a simple evening meal without taking over cooking or making Mara monitor every bite.

daniel.activity: Rest on the sofa with the television low, taking small drinks and speaking only when needed.
daniel.intention: Be near Mara for a little company while keeping the evening calm.

daniel.activity: Take more cold medicine only if the label interval allows, drink water, and brush my teeth slowly.
daniel.intention: Settle symptoms and handle basic evening hygiene before sleep.

daniel.activity: Change into sleep clothes and put the worn evening clothes in the laundry hamper.
daniel.intention: Get comfortable without starting any unnecessary household task.

daniel.activity: Sleep, waking briefly for water or tissues if necessary.
daniel.intention: Recover overnight and be ready to reassess the illness tomorrow.
